noAccess.title: This area isn't available for {{role}}
noAccess.body: Your role keeps this section with someone else. Here is what you can do:

denied.notOwn: You can only change records you own.
denied.notTeam: This record belongs to another team.
denied.leadAssign: Sales Executives can't reassign leads. You can ask your manager: Request reassignment.
denied.leadDelete: Sales Executives can't delete leads. Mark the lead as Lost instead.
denied.leadViewHni: HNI details are visible to managers and admins only.
denied.importProperties: Bulk property import is kept with the admin so the inventory stays accurate.
denied.teamView: The team view is for managers and admins.
denied.propertyDelete: Only the admin can delete properties. Change its status to On hold or Sold instead.
denied.userManage: Only the admin can add, activate or deactivate users.
